title: What the Worker can do
description: The Worker's two capabilities beyond serving the page.

entities.name: GitHub sign-in
entities.description: Signs a reader in with GitHub, keeping their token where the page can't read it.
entities.responsibility: Runs GitHub's OAuth code flow with PKCE, holds the resulting token in a sealed HttpOnly cookie, says who is signed in and signs them out.
access: Off unless GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET and SESSION_SECRET are all set (configured).
Anyone may start a sign-in; it completes only in the browser holding the matching sealed state.
Signing out is accepted only with the app's own Origin.

entities.name: Reading GitHub for a signed-in reader
entities.description: A read-only door to the part of GitHub's API the page needs.
entities.responsibility: Forwards the page's reads of the reader's account, repositories, trees and files to GitHub with the reader's token, and passes the answer back without it.
access: GET only, and only the paths in ALLOWED, with no . or .. segment.

relatedViews.relationship: The routes through which they are reached.
The page's capability to read a repository uses them for a signed-in reader.
